must.title: Security Requirements
must.description: Ensure secure handling of documents during flow.
must.metric: Zero critical vulnerabilities in SAST scan
acceptance_criteria: Security scans show zero critical vulnerabilities.
Data encryption is applied to document flows.
Access controls are verified and enforced.

must.title: Reliability Requirements
must.description: Ensure reliable document flow without interruptions.
acceptance_criteria: Automatic failover mechanisms are in place.

should.title: Performance Requirements
should.description: Ensure the system processes document flows with minimal latency.
should.metric: Document flow latency under 200ms for 95% of requests
acceptance_criteria: System handles peak load without degradation.
Performance metrics are logged and monitored.
should.verification: Load test at 10× expected peak; measure p95/p99

should.title: Scalability Requirements
should.description: Ensure the system can scale to handle increased document flow.
acceptance_criteria: Scalability tests confirm support for 10,000 concurrent flows.
System performance remains stable under load.
Scalability metrics are logged and monitored.
should.verification: Scalability test with concurrent user simulation
